posts.title: Going to Production: Azure Kubernetes Service for R Shiny
posts.excerpt: Part 3 of 3: AKS node pools, container registry, Key Vault secrets, OIDC authentication, Log Analytics monitoring, and zero-downtime deployments for a production Shiny cluster on Azure.

posts.title: Validate Before You Spend: A Local Kubernetes Rig for R Shiny
posts.excerpt: Part 2 of 3: Build a full local Kubernetes cluster with Colima and k3s to validate your Shiny stack before touching Azure. Covers upgrade testing, maxPods sizing, Apple Silicon emulation, and session behavior testing.

posts.title: Running R Shiny at Scale: Why Kubernetes Changes Everything
posts.excerpt: Part 1 of 3: The problem with traditional Shiny deployments and the component stack — ShinyProxy, Kubernetes, Redis Sentinel, ingress-nginx, cert-manager — that solves it. No prior Kubernetes experience required.

posts.title: Docker Optimization Part 2: Intelligent Caching for R Shiny Applications
posts.excerpt: Advanced Docker caching strategies: hash-based base images, cache busting for external packages, and tests as build gates. Learn how we reduced base image rebuilds by 85% and made tests a mandatory build gate.

posts.title: Optimizing R Shiny Docker Builds: Warm vs Cold Build Strategy
posts.excerpt: How we optimized Docker builds for a customer-facing R Shiny SaaS application by separating code changes (8-15 min) from dependency changes (40 min) and reduced image sizes by 42%. Learn the practical techniques that transformed our CI/CD pipeline at Alamar Biosciences.
